notes: Evals 1-3 on Haiku 4.5. With the skill: 3/3 one-page PDFs; baseline 1/3. The baseline chose wrong articles ('Місяць', 'Зірка'), used a different concept as the Polish equivalent (+321%), and computed 'growth' as last week vs first week.
With-skill weaknesses found: a single article for a broad topic, relative growth not explained, the geo note misread as 'diaspora', '+7% [-20%, +43%]' called growth.
